svg.title: Eight appends into a dynamic array that doubles its capacity
svg.desc: Appending 5, 8, 2, 9, 4, 7, 1, 6 starting at capacity 1. Resizes on the 2nd, 3rd and 5th appends copy 1, 2 and 4 elements; total copies 7. Blue marks the element just appended; empty cells are reserved but unused.
svg.text: append 8 values, starting at capacity 1, doubling when full
